correctness.rationale: All-q cycle-class chain covers every length-two vertex exactly once; each connector crosses to a new class and cannot be traversed backward. All internal transitions follow a deterministic directed 1- or 2-cycle, so any Euler trail with the fixed initial 2-symbol state and the given 3-factor counts is forced. The injection from positive cycle multiplicities gives the exact rational series. Partial-fraction asymptotic has a pole of order R at z=1 and at most order H<R elsewhere; Theorem 6.1 of arXiv:1605.03319v1 independently provides the matching O exponent. Extracted standalone code checks q=2..7 structure, q=2..4 uniqueness, and binary exhaustive grouping n=8..15. These finite computations are not substituted for the general proof.

value.rationale: The primary 2016 source explicitly conjectures this sharp exponent in all k and q; proving the k=3 case for all fixed alphabet sizes meets a literature-motivated gap. The construction selects all R=q(q+1)/2 necklace cycles, not a fragile finite example, and its exact rational enumerator yields explicit positive lower asymptotics for every q. The result is a mathematically natural infinite family that resolves one entire factor-length slice, with limits to k=3 and subfamily counting made explicit.
